sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog BR
sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 tops 39 million players
sources.text: More than 39 million unique users have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 as of November 22, making it the biggest launch in PlayStation history across three decades and five console generations, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced . The sequel set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Across PlayStation 5, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in Grand Theft Auto VI , and have spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the game’s world during its opening days. Grand Theft Auto VI ‘s launch also marked the largest number of newly connected PlayStation 5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since launch, it was the first played game on 70 percent of new PlayStation 5 consoles. “We want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2 ,” Sony Interactive Entertainment content communications manager Tim Turi said. “With [ Grand Theft Auto VI ], we worked to bring the best experience on [PlayStation 5] and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI : The Festival in Miami this past weekend.” Grand Theft Auto VI launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on November 19. On November 20, Rockstar Games announced that the game achieved $3.79 billion in day one retail sales following 32.5 million pre-sales. Although Rockstar Games did not share exact unit numbers, the revenue total suggests roughly 37.9 million to 47.3 million copies sold, based solely on pricing across its $79.99 and $99.99 editions.

sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: GTA 6 was the "biggest launch in PlayStation history", with the highest number of concurrent players ever
sources.text: Release day saw a spike in newly connected PS5 consoles, although falling short of year-end highs Christmas did not come early for Sony, but it came close: the firm has declared that GTA 6 was the largest game launch in the platform's history, driving a record number of concurrent players on its November 19th launch, although the number of new consoles playing the game fell short of year-end highs. A post on the PlayStation Blog said the game has attracted more than 39 million unique players since launch, who have cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay. The average total playtime was 17.4 hours, the firm said. The GTA 6 launch day saw a strong but not unprecedented spike in new console usage, which Sony described as the largest number of connected consoles in a single day aside from the console launch and end-of-year holidays. GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PlayStation consoles. Xbox has made no public statements as to the game's success on its platform. Data from Ampere Analysis suggested strong initial performance due to the relative ease with which users could set their location to New Zealand and start playing early, with over two million players getting early access on the platform . Subsequent data from Circana indicated that over 56% of global Xbox players had engaged with the game on launch day. Rockstar previously announced that pre-orders for the game totalled 32.5 million units, achieving $3.79 billion in retail sales revenue on its first day , a new record for an entertainment release.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Sony: GTA 6 set record for 'highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation' ever
sources.text: The industry is finding new milestones to measure GTA 6's success. GTA 6 has been shattering records since before it came out, becoming the top-rated game in the history of Metacritic before it had the biggest entertainment launch (by dollars) in history. Sony is now joining in that victory lap by sharing GTA 6 milestones as they pertain to PlayStation. "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5," Sony content communications manager Tim Turi wrote in a blog post today. That is a staggering number, especially considering GTA 6 also launched on Xbox and will (eventually) hit PC . But that's not a sales record—Rockstar still has a ways to go to surpass GTA 5's 230 million lifetime sales . What is unprecedented, at least for PlayStation, is GTA 6's concurrents over launch weekend. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles," Turi said. That's the wild one to me, because that means more people were playing GTA 6 at the same time on the largest console platform than Call of Duty, GTA 5 , or even Fortnite has ever achieved. Turi didn't share the concurrent figure itself, which is too bad—Steam remains the only platform that hands out exact player data. If the figure is theoretically higher than some of the biggest concurrent peaks we know about on Steam, then it could've been as high as 3-4 million players. On average, those 39 million PS5 players logged 17.4 hours over four days. Let's just say my hour count represents the higher end of that average, and I'm still less than halfway through the main story. sources.title: GTA 6 is "biggest launch in PlayStation history," with Sony reporting over 39 million players on PS5
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the "first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles" GTA 6 isn't just smashing records as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic – it's also apparently surpassing massive milestones on consoles like the PlayStation 5. So much so, in fact, that Sony now reports Rockstar's long-awaited new Grand Theft Auto is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history" – ever, ever. That's a nearly 32-year-long history. The company reveals as much in a new blog post , writing, "The launch of GTA 6 marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations." Sony goes on to specify just how many players constitute "the biggest" release: "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5." Nearly 40 million. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles." That's no small feat, considering this includes… well, everything. From online games like Fortnite to more recent single-player launches like Ghost of Tsushima sequel Ghost of Yotei – and everything before them on every single PlayStation system to date. And, it appears folks helping set this record on PS5 are actually spending quite a bit of time in Grand Theft Auto 6 as well… not just purchasing it. "Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6," as Sony writes," reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game's opening days." That's not bad, considering just how behemoth-like Rockstar seems. It's only been a few days, and the community is clearly engaging with it. GTA 6 is boosting console sales, too. Sony apparently "saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console's launch, outside of end-of-year holidays." And, "since its launch, GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles." This all checks out – heck, following the GTA 6 extended look on Netflix in August, we saw a surge in both PS5 and Xbox Series X sales . When it comes to the new Grand Theft Auto, we're talking about a mind-boggling $3.79 billion launch across platforms – and it's not even out on PC yet. sources.title: How to find the laptop password in GTA 6
sources.text: Break into Boogie’s laptop using clues found in the apartment The GTA 6 laptop password appears in Chapter 3, when Jason and Lucia end up borrowing an apartment from a friend of a friend called Boogie. In the bedroom, there’s a conspicuous open laptop that requires a password to get into. If you’re curious, all the clues can be found in the apartment, and you’ll get a pretty nice ride out of it, too – at least once you find the location it hints towards. The GTA 6 laptop pass word is Muffins Queen 15, found from various clues around the house. Below I'll run through all the info you need to find what you want. When you first find the laptop you’ll be able to put in a few guesses, but none of them will be right. Instead, you’ll need to unlock the correct prompts by searching around your safehouse. First, head to the entrance hallway to find the shrine to Boogie’s dog (above). By examining the picture you’ll find out the dog’s name was Muffins. But the password is a bit more secure than that. Head back into the bedroom to find the next clue on the bedside table. The notebook shows Muffins wearing a crown, but that’s not all. Flip it over to find a message: “Class of ‘15 reunion next Friday.” Once you’ve done that, you have all the clues you need. Go back to the laptop and follow the prompts to enter “Muffins,” “Queen,” and “15.” Once inside, don’t forget to flip through Boogie’s messages to find a clue about where to find your reward: Vanessa's Pink Porsche , in the garage near a restaurant near Auntie’s Place. You’ll automatically pick up the code to get in, too. But you might not be able to find the garage immediately – it’s not marked on the map. sources.text: Did you know there’s a Tractor Revenge encounter in GTA 6 where you have to spread manure over someone’s house? Here’s a guide that explains how to do it. In a game like GTA 6 , players always need to keep their ears and eyes open, because you never know what weird, absurd adventure you’ll suddenly become part of while calmly cruising down the road. One such event is Caleb’s revenge story against his mistreating ex-boss, Stacey, and this guide explains how to find the encounter and what you need to do. You can also buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! The Tractor Revenge Encounter in GTA 6 can be found on a highway while driving towards Frogswater. While driving from the motel to Frogswater in Chapter 2, players will encounter an erratic tractor on the highway (the exact location is marked with a blue star in the screenshot above). The tractor is being operated by an NPC named Caleb, who is heavily under the influence of alcohol and is causing a disturbance with his reckless driving, leading to traffic congestion on the road. To initiate this encounter, players should approach the tractor and press and hold up on the D-Pad to Taunt/Question Caleb. sources.title: GTA 6 Security Expert Mission Walkthrough: How To Find And Rescue Nicole
sources.text: Recruit Nicole in the Security Expert mission in GTA 6 Wondering how to complete Security Expert in GTA 6? Security Expert is one of the missions that lead up to Chapter 3’s finale, The Cartel Heist. This mission continues directly from the last mission, Sinfrontera National Bank . In this mission you’ll kidnap Nicole, a security expert that will help with the heist. Check out our GTA 6 Guides Hub for dozens of guides laying out everything you need to know about Rockstar ‘s latest epic. We’ve also got a complete GTA 6 walkthrough in progress, which you can bookmark and return to as you progress through the game. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Once the previous mission ends, the game will automatically cut to Jason and Lucia travel to Waning Sands in Leonard County to locate Nicole. There is no separate mission marker to find beforehand, as Security Expert starts automatically. Drive towards the marked location in Waning Sands. As you approach the house, Jason will ask you to drive past slowly so you can assess the guards. The place is swarming with security, so you’re going to have to sneak in. Continue past the property and park your vehicle nearby. Follow Jason around the back of the property. Wait for a guard to leave through the back door before entering. Once inside, cross the hallway and head towards the closed bedroom in the north-east corner of the house. Use Focus Mode to keep tabs on where the security guards are in the house. We don’t know if being spotted triggers a mission failure, or a shootout. A cutscene will play, after which Nicole will be unconscious on the floor. Pick Nicole up and follow Jason back outside. It’s important to stay directly behind him as you make your way around the property. This allows you to avoid the guards without triggering an alarm. Once you reach your car, open the boot and launch Nicole inside. If you have a stash in the boot of your car from a previous crime, the game will ignore it for this mission, so you’ll always be able to stash her. Leave the area quickly and drive towards Raul’s planning room in Stockyard. Once you arrive, a cutscene will reveal why Raul wanted Nicole. He knows she’s been stealing from La Polilla Negra and explains that her bosses in the cartel intends to kill her after her current assignment. Nicole agrees to join Raul’s crew, completing the mission. That’s everything you need to know about how to complete Security Expert in GTA 6. Security Expert doesn’t provide a cash reward. However, successfully completing the mission recruits Nicole Park to Raul’s crew, providing an important specialist for the upcoming Cartel Heist.

sources.title: Acts of Blood for PC delayed to spring 2027
sources.text: Publisher Big Fan Games and developer Eksil Team have delayed beat ’em up action game Acts of Blood from its previously planned December 4, 2026 release to spring 2027 for PC via Steam and Microsoft Store . PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series versions are also due out in 2027. Here is the full message from Eksil Team on the delay: With heavy heart we’re making a difficult decision to postpone the release of the game on PC (Steam) into spring 2027. We know the decision might disappoint for you, whom already looking forward to play our game on December. But after assessing the feedback we got from players, play testers, and internal team, we found several issues that still can be improved with a little bit more time, and hopefully it will deliver the best experience we intended.

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: GTA 6 just got a patch that fixed a progression bug on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
sources.text: Rockstar just issued a new patch for GTA 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, targeting a few issues players have been reporting since the game launched last Thursday (19th November). The 23rd November patch for the game deploys seven major fixes for the game, including a pretty significant bug that prevented phone calls not triggering at certain points, resulting in a scenario where you could be locked out of progressing the game. The official update is titled 'version 01.002.002', and its weighs in at different sizes on different consoles: it's 603.8 MB on PS5, and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X/S. Thanks to an update on the Rockstar website , you can read all of the updates that arrive with the latest pathc below. There have been a few fairly high-profile cases of the autosave not working as the developer intended, leading to a few cases of streamers losing plenty of real-world time thanks to unpredictable auto-save behaviour. JasonTheWeen lost 12 hours of progress on the PS5 , for example. But there's one issue here the developer hasn't addressed: vignetting. Plenty of players have taken to online communities to complain about the vignette effect that pops into the game - theoretically to help with motion smoothing and various grapihcal elements as the game runs in 30FPS. THe effect is worsened when you're fatigued, hungry, or have some other status effect, but it is present quite a lot of the time, too. Most of the responses to a tweet about the patch posted by the Rockstar Support account reference the vignetting in GTA 6, and the developer has issued no response at the time of writing.

sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Bug de GTA 6 destrava fps no Xbox Series X|S e revela limites de desempenho
sources.text: Dica para deixar GTA 6 no padrão brasileiro: veja como mudar unidades de medida Um bug relacionado ao Quick Resume do Xbox Series X|S destrava a taxa de quadros por segundo de GTA 6 . A falha permitiu testar os limites dos consoles da Microsoft e reforça que, embora exista uma margem de desempenho considerável, a trava de 30 fps é interessante para manter uma experiência consistente, concluiu o Digital Foundry . Um relato sobre o bug foi publicado pelo u/Meowwie64 no subreddit r/gtaglitches. No texto, ele descreve como reproduzir a falha nos consoles Xbox Series X|S. A Rockstar lançou Grand Theft Auto 6 com desempenho travado em 30 quadros por segundo em todos os consoles — Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 e PlayStation 5 Pro. O jogo foi desenvolvido pensando em alcançar essa taxa de quadros . Sem a trava de 30 fps, o console pode renderizar quantos quadros por segundo seu hardware permitir . Isso é basicamente o que acontece nos computadores em muitos jogos, exceto naqueles que limitam a taxa de quadros a um valor específico por razões técnicas. Para reproduzir o glitch , é necessário ter um Xbox Series X|S, um display com suporte à taxa de atualização de 120 Hz e GTA 6 na versão 01.002.001 . O autor da publicação não menciona a versão específica do firmware do console, porém, considerando o comportamento da falha, esse também pode ser um fator relevante para o procedimento. O processo para reproduzir o glitch é relativamente simples: Se tudo foi feito no momento certo, GTA 6 provavelmente estará com a taxa de quadros destravada . Isso permite que o console renderize imagens acima do limite de 30 fps definido pela Rockstar. A reprodução acima de 30 fps é resultado de um bug cuja causa ainda não foi identificada, mas que provavelmente será resolvido por um patch de correção . Além disso, apesar de o Xbox Series S também permitir reproduzir a falha, o hardware mais limitado do console não consegue renderizar muitos quadros além do limite original. O site e canal do YouTube Digital Foundry testou o glitch e avaliou como o Xbox Series X reproduz GTA 6 sem o limite na taxa de quadros. Em boa parte da jogabilidade, o console da Microsoft consegue entregar mais de 30 fps, mas o desempenho está longe de ser estável . Segundo o veículo, trechos muito movimentados (tiroteios, explosões e perseguições) fazem o desempenho cair abaixo dos 30 fps , assim como acontece na jogabilidade sem o glitch . Dirigir em alta velocidade por rodovias urbanas também faz a taxa de quadros se aproximar do limite original. Porém, em trechos mais tranquilos ou ao dirigir em alta velocidade por rodovias menos movimentadas, o console consegue alcançar 40 fps ou mais. Nos testes do Digital Foundry , o Xbox Series X chegou a 60 fps ao pilotar um avião e olhar diretamente para o céu — uma situação pouco frequente durante a jogatina convencional. Contudo, a taxa de quadros adicional vem com efeitos colaterais: por algum motivo, o jogo parece rodar de forma acelerada quando alcança taxas mais elevadas . O game ainda é jogável, mas o comportamento reforça que a reprodução acima de 30 fps não estava prevista e pode comprometer algumas animações. No Xbox Series S, destravar a taxa de quadros não traz muitos benefícios . O console consegue reproduzir o game com mais de 30 quadros por segundo em determinados cenários, como cutscenes ou ao olhar diretamente para o céu em áreas abertas, mas os ganhos são limitados. Isso acontece porque destravar a taxa de quadros não garante mais desempenho magicamente . Sem o bloqueio original, o console fica limitado ao potencial do próprio hardware, e os testes já mostraram que GTA 6 é um título bastante pesado até para os videogames da atual geração. Quer ficar por dentro das novidades do mundo dos games? Acesse o VOXL e acompanhe as últimas notícias sobre GTA 6 , Xbox e desempenho nos consoles. /Com informações de Digital Foundry . stories.summary: Responsáveis por Cyberpunk 2 rasgam elogios a GTA 6.

sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Diretor de Cyberpunk 2 diz que o jogo está “cancelado” após entrar em “depressão pós-GTA 6”
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 finalmente chegou na última quinta (19) e já está levando jogadores para explorar as ruas de Vice City e outras regiões de Leonida. Enquanto muita gente descobre os detalhes espalhados pelo mapa, outros estão impressionados com o nível de vida e interação do mundo aberto da Rockstar. Um deles é Igor Sarzyński, diretor criativo de Cyberpunk 2 , que compartilhou nas redes sociais sua reação ao novo jogo. O desenvolvedor brincou que a sequência do RPG futurista havia sido “cancelada” depois de conhecer GTA 6 , dizendo estar passando por uma espécie de depressão pós-jogo. A publicação chamou a atenção justamente por vir de alguém que também trabalha na criação de mundos abertos. Apesar da brincadeira, Sarzyński aproveitou para elogiar o trabalho da Rockstar e explicar os motivos pelos quais considera o jogo um acontecimento tão impressionante. Em publicação no Bluesky, Sarzyński comentou que a “depressão de desenvolvedor de jogos de mundo aberto induzida por GTA 6 é real”. Na sequência, ele descreveu o lançamento da Rockstar como “provavelmente a maior conquista artística da história”. O diretor destacou características como escala, densidade, coerência e atenção aos detalhes, classificando o resultado como “simplesmente um milagre tecnológico e criativo”. Foi nesse contexto que ele brincou: “ Cyberpunk 2 foi cancelado, vou varrer as folhas de outono no meu quintal agora”. Apesar da provocação, Sarzyński fez questão de separar a admiração por GTA 6 do trabalho que sua equipe está desenvolvendo. Em outra publicação, ele afirmou acreditar que Cyberpunk 2 está seguindo um caminho próprio, com uma proposta diferente da experiência da Rockstar. “Acho que estamos fazendo algo original, com um toque único e diferente”, explicou o desenvolvedor. Para ele, GTA 6 é impressionante justamente por expandir as possibilidades do que pode ser feito em um jogo, com uma visão bem definida e execução extremamente cuidadosa. Sarzyński não foi o único integrante da CD Projekt RED a comentar o lançamento epopeico de GTA 6 . Michal Nowakowski, co-CEO do estúdio, também parabenizou a Rockstar e afirmou que pretende explorar o novo jogo durante as próximas semanas e meses. Nas redes sociais, Nowakowski chamou GTA 6 de “obra-prima” e destacou o tamanho do desafio enfrentado pela equipe responsável pelo projeto. “É inacreditavelmente difícil alcançar o que vocês acabaram de fazer. Tiro o chapéu para todos vocês”, declarou. A conta oficial de Cyberpunk 2077 também entrou na conversa para celebrar a chegada do novo jogo. “De Night City a Vice City, enviando amor de costa a costa”, publicou o perfil em uma mensagem que parabenizou a Rockstar pelo lançamento. Outros desenvolvedores também compartilharam elogios. Pawel Sasko, diretor associado de Cyberpunk 2 , destacou a profundidade do mundo e a atenção aos detalhes, enquanto Sebastian Kalemba, diretor do também aguardadíssimo The Witcher 4 , afirmou estar ansioso para passar os próximos dias explorando o jogo.
